# Preview-only cut-out images

Used only by the local fixture preview (`index.html?cutouts=1`) to show how dish photos with a transparent
background float in the Charbon theme. They are served from `/fixture-images/` by `tests/fixtures/server.mjs`,
not from `assets/`, and are never part of a restaurant's real menu.

Downloaded on 22 November 2026 from Wikimedia Commons as 960px renditions.
